factions.name: Orc
factions.description: Battle Hardened: at 2/4 Orcs, all allies gain a large max-HP bonus (+100, then +300). Members include Axe, Beastmaster, Chen, Disruptor, Juggernaut and Warlock.

factions.name: Undead
factions.description: Plague: at 3 Undead, all non-Undead enemies suffer -20% max HP. Members include Abaddon, Death Prophet, Drow Ranger, Lich, Necrophos, Spectre and Vengeful Spirit.

factions.name: Demon
factions.description: Chaotic beings that emerged from a dimensional fissure; a high-damage late-game race including Shadow Fiend, Chaos Knight, Queen of Pain, Terrorblade, Doom and Sven.

factions.name: Naga
factions.description: Small race granting allied magic resistance (+20% at 2 Naga); anchored by Tidehunter.

factions.name: Goblin
factions.description: Compact 6-piece race that pairs tightly with the Mech class; includes Techies, Bounty Hunter and Alchemist.

factions.name: Knight
factions.description: Holy defenders class: at 2 Knights, allies have a 40% chance to gain a shield granting 80% magic resistance and 30 armor for 3 seconds. Members include Abaddon and Dragon Knight.

factions.name: Assassin
factions.description: Backline executioners: at 3/6 Assassins, all friendly Assassins gain a 15% chance to critical strike for 350%/450% damage. Members include Phantom Assassin, Templar Assassin, Shadow Fiend, Queen of Pain and Bounty Hunter.

factions.name: Mage
factions.description: At 3/6 Mages, enemy magic resistance is reduced by 35%/45%, amplifying allied magic damage. Members include Lich and Crystal Maiden.

factions.name: Warlock
factions.description: Grants allied lifesteal; scales into a strong sustain class. Members include Enigma, Death Prophet, Necrophos and Alchemist.

factions.name: Hunter
factions.description: Ranged damage class granting a team-wide damage bonus (about +25% at 3 Hunters). Members include Beastmaster, Tidehunter and Drow Ranger.

cards.name: Axe
cards.description: Cheap early-game Orc/Warrior tank valued for durability and cleave-like counter damage.

cards.name: Bounty Hunter
cards.description: 1-gold Goblin/Assassin used to bridge early Goblin/Mech boards into Assassin synergy.

cards.name: Juggernaut
cards.description: 2-gold Orc/Warrior with strong physical burst via his Omnislash ultimate.

cards.name: Crystal Maiden
cards.description: 2-gold Human/Mage providing crowd control and magic damage for Mage lineups.

cards.name: Lich
cards.description: Iconic 2-gold Undead/Mage; strong value pick that anchors both Undead and Mage synergies.

cards.name: Beastmaster
cards.description: Orc/Hunter used in Hunter-focused lineups for extra Orc HP scaling.

cards.name: Drow Ranger
cards.description: Undead/Hunter combining physical ranged damage with the Undead Plague debuff.

cards.name: Abaddon
cards.description: Undead/Knight commonly paired with Drow Ranger for an early Undead(2) bonus.

cards.name: Dragon Knight
cards.description: Dragon/Knight used as the backbone of physical Knight and Dragon lineups.

cards.name: Phantom Assassin
cards.description: 3-gold Assassin-class unit prized for its high critical-strike burst potential.

cards.name: Shadow Fiend
cards.description: Demon/Assassin dealing heavy burst damage, scaling well with the Assassin crit synergy.

cards.name: Necrophos
cards.description: Undead/Warlock providing sustain and anti-heal utility for Undead/Warlock boards.

cards.name: Alchemist
cards.description: 4-gold Goblin/Warlock whose Acid Spray AoE reduces enemy armor while dealing damage.

cards.name: Death Prophet
cards.description: 5-gold Undead/Warlock late-game carry whose Exorcism spirits deal sustained ranged damage.

cards.name: Enigma
cards.description: 5-gold Element/Warlock; Midnight Pulse deals pure percentage-health damage to all enemies in range.

cards.name: Techies
cards.description: 5-gold Goblin/Mech, one of only six Goblin pieces and key to completing Mech HP-regen synergy.

cards.name: Tidehunter
cards.description: 5-gold Naga/Hunter whose Ravage ultimate stuns and damages the entire enemy board.

cards.name: Sven
cards.description: 5-gold Demon/Warrior, a top-tier late-game physical carry with a large attack-buff ultimate.

cards.name: Queen of Pain
cards.description: 5-gold Demon/Assassin dealing heavy AoE magic burst, fitting both Demon and Assassin boards.

cards.name: Gyrocopter
cards.description: 5-gold Dwarf/Mech, the fifth and final piece needed to complete the Mech synergy.
